scope: Three boots of one TP3/r5o image sharing the first boot cost table; no old/new image comparison.
limits: step_ms is derived from acceptance and throughput, not independent GPU timing
historical main has only three samples and a different image ID
pinning effect versus unpinned boots is not isolated
one-stream 256-token responses; not full promotion qualification

live_problems: dgx1: dgx-fan-control.service is enabled/inactive, expected enabled/active; run sudo systemctl enable --now dgx-fan-control.service
dgx2: dgx-fan-control.service is enabled/inactive, expected enabled/active; run sudo systemctl enable --now dgx-fan-control.service
dgx3: dgx-fan-control.service is enabled/inactive, expected enabled/active; run sudo systemctl enable --now dgx-fan-control.service
